classification.difficultyReason: Count equal-area parts relative to one square and combine shaded parts across two squares while retaining the denominator for a single whole.

content.prompt: What fraction does each of the shaded areas represent, given that the area of the large square is 1 in each case?

spec.description: A four-by-four square with its left three columns shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a permanent given; numerical answer is hidden.

template.shadeReason: The twelve shaded cells are the quantity whose fraction of one large square is requested.

answer.worked:
The whole square has 16 equal cells, and 12 are shaded.

$$\frac{12}{16}=\frac34$$

spec.description: Two equal three-by-three squares side by side; only the middle row of the left square and all of the right square are shaded.
spec.mathematics: Each square is one whole, so twelve shaded cells represent twelve ninths.
spec.answerVisibility: Both shaded models are permanent givens.

template.shadeReason: Three cells of the first whole and all nine cells of the second whole are shaded.

answer.worked:
Each whole contains 9 equal cells. There are $3+9=12$ shaded cells across the two squares.

$$\frac{12}{9}=\frac43$$

spec.description: Two equal squares, each divided into four smaller squares with upper-left to lower-right diagonals. The template cannot express triangular half-cell shading.
spec.mathematics: Four of eight equal triangles shaded in the left square and three of eight in the right square.
spec.answerVisibility: Seven shaded triangular regions are permanent givens.

answer.worked: Each large square contains 8 equal triangles. The two squares have $4+3=7$ shaded triangles altogether, representing $\frac78$ of one large square.

spec.description: A rotated square partitioned into eight equal triangular sectors, alternating unshaded and shaded clockwise from the top vertex. The template cannot express this rotated square partition.
spec.mathematics: Four of eight equal regions are shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Alternating shading is a permanent given.

answer.worked:
The whole square has 8 equal triangles, and 4 are shaded.

$$\frac48=\frac12$$
